Summary: A Roman senator and historian whose Annals, written in the early 2nd century, cover the reigns of the early emperors. Key work: Annals.
KeyPoints: Annals 15.44 states Christus suffered the extreme penalty under Tiberius at the hands of Pontius Pilate; The movement originated in Judaea and spread to Rome, where Nero blamed Christians and punished them; A hostile Roman source independently confirms the time, place, governing authority, and founder
